BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Baavgai!!
Oh, just you? You made it!
Wait, look...
Shortie, you made it too!\nWell, good job!
*panting*\nSummit...treasure...rewards...\nYes, I made it...
Er...congrats?
What made you so tired?
Anyway, good job!
What a spirit and determination!\nI hope those who failed will learn from you.\nWell...
You two got here first at almost the same time.\nBut, I think we still need to decide the winner.
No, I don't think it's necessary to make them\nfight until there's one person left.\nAnd besides, Caylass, this adventurer...
Alright, the final battle will be a one-on-one\nfight! We'll be the judges and watch until\nthe end, so fight to your heart's content!
You're so naive!
Take my Ingrizzible Dual Swords ultimate move!\nDouble Slash!!
Way to go, Baavgai ♪! You can do anything\nincluding deceiving and surprising your opponent!\nA warrior should be like that!
Er, actually a warrior is...
You're doing pretty good!\nWell, what about this?
Ingrizzible Dual Swords secret move! Avalanche!!
What, you dodged that too?\nAll right, what about this?
Ingrizzible Dual Swords ultimate secret move!
Flamethrower!!
Oh, nice!\nHe doesn't depend on his swords to attack!\nHe shows great potential!
To be more exact, it seems that he's not using his\nswords at all...
You two please just don't get yourselves injured!
Hmm...It was unbelievable that my Ingrizzible Dual\nSwords didn't work. I guess there are still many\nthings to learn in life.
Did you even use your swords...?
Well, Baavgai, you did great too!\nNow let's go down the mountain and inform everyone\nthat the sakura warrior has been decided!
Um, Caylass, you haven't forgot that\nthe adventurer is from another world, have you?
Huh? No, I haven't. Why though?
I don't think we can't keep the adventurer here to\nwatch the sakura world and protect the tree...
Oops!\nI totally forgot!!
Don't tell me you were gonna make the adventurer\nthe sakura warrior?
Well, I know you were not thinking about it,\nbut how could you not realize it until the end...?
Oh no, so that means no one can be the sakura\nwarrior now. No way, what should we do now?
In that case, this time the runner-up can be the\nsakura warrior.
W-what? Is that okay though?
Yes, will you please?
O-of course!\nI'll protect your tree with my Ingrizzible Dual\nSwords!
Okay, we shall go down the mountain then.\nLet's tell everyone that the sakura warrior has\nbeen chosen...
Oh, it's you!
What are you doing here?\nI thought you've become a sakura warrior.\nDon't you need to protect Celesa's tree?
Yeah, there's something I wanna try with my\nIngrizzible Dual Swords. I got the idea when I was\nfighting with this adventurer.
I came here to try it before I forget, but\napparently it's not possible without an opponent.\nSo, may I ask you to have a duel with me?
Wait, you never use your swords though...\nBut, if that's what you want, it's fine, I guess.\nHey, go be his opponent!
